_comment: Camera-ready GuacaMol generation, NeurIPS 2026 submission 24168.
Rules: docs/camera_ready/RUN_RULES.md (binding, incl. its amendment log).
Runner: scripts/cr/run_cell.py (R-1), one fresh process per (arm, task, seed) cell.
Driver: scripts/cr/cr_queue.py. Every arm runs the 11 paper tasks x its 40 seeds = 440 cells (R-5):
the seeds 42-81 of the top-level 'seeds' list unless the arm has its own 'seeds' list (its seed
range). Two arms may share (solver, run_overrides) only with disjoint seed ranges; the queue and
run_cell refuse a seed outside an arm's range.
'arm' is the unique id (output directory output_root/<arm>); 'solver' is the name
run_benchmark._create_solver resolves; 'run_overrides' changes R-1 defaults for that arm
only (allowed: subspace_dim 8 or 64, the R-1 exception of the amendment log); it is
passed to run_cell, tags the file name (_sd8 / _sd64, as the CLI does) and is recorded
in the file's provenance.
host_class 'gpu' arms may run only on gpu_hosts (panda's 2x L40S); 'cpu' arms (GaBO
family) run with no GPU visible on cpu_hosts, which is kajman only (R-2 and its amendment
of 2026-10-12: one kajman queue with one worker; GaBO depends on the CPU microarchitecture).
timeout_s is a per-cell wall-clock cap that only catches hangs (every decode is already
capped at 30 s); it is NOT a method parameter. A timed-out cell is a crash (R-8).
Classes: 3600 s GeoWalk-type (surrogate-free), 7200 s candidate-set GP, 14400 s
GP-continuous (incl. rembo/hesbo/GaBO), 21600 s papenmeier_msr_published* and turbo_box_faithful.
Waves are priority only: 1 = main-table arms and the amendment arms, 2 = faithful-domain
and published-method companions, 3 = new and external-in-harness baselines, 3b = the
superseded -3sigma box arms and their [min,max] argmax twin, 4 = run only if capacity remains.
Control block (RUN_RULES amendment of 2026-10-12): it runs from its own commit (tag
cr-controls-2026-10-12) into its own output root (results/guacamol/cr2026ctl). Wave c1 = C1
hvarfner_scaled_gp_box_argmax_raw, C2a hvarfner_scaled_gp_boxdir_argmax and C2b random_boxdir on
seeds 42-81; wave c2 = C3, the six decomposition arms on seeds 82-121 under the ids <arm>__s82 (own
directories; their files record the base solver and provenance.cr_arm = <arm>__s82).
Control C4 (RUN_RULES amendment of 2026-10-14): wave c3 = hvarfner_scaled_gp_sphere_lbfgs on seeds
42-81, run from its own commit (tag cr-controls-lbfgs-2026-10-14) into the control block's root; the
printed shell x continuous cell of the factorial since 2026-11-06 (RUN_RULES 2026-11-06 16:30).
